name: The Lustful Touch
source:
The Lustful Touch is an 18+ visual novel in which massage becomes more than just a service, but a revelation. Hidden desires, subtle emotions, and touches that can break down the boundaries between care and temptation. One meeting. One session. Everything can change.

Tony is a young masseur just starting his career at a prestigious salon. His hands can relieve pain, and his attention can awaken what many women don't even dare to talk about. Each client has her own story, trauma, or secret desire. But what if one of the sessions turns into something more than just work?

When passion meets trust and the body becomes a conduit for emotions, every choice can lead to love, addiction, or destruction. Among the clients are married women, romantically entangled souls, and those looking for something they can't quite name. And every touch brings Tony closer to realizing his true role.

The Lustful Touch is a story about how intimacy can heal, destroy, and reveal itself anew. It's a game about boundaries—personal, moral, and physical—and how easy it is to blur them when feelings are at stake.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3787020/The_Lustful_Touch/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《欲望之触》是一部18岁以上的视觉小说，其中按摩不再只是一种服务，而是一种启示。隐藏的欲望、微妙的情感和触动可以打破关心和诱惑之间的界限。一次会议。一届会议。一切都可以改变。

托尼是一位年轻的按摩师，刚刚在一家著名的沙龙开始他的职业生涯。他的双手可以缓解疼痛，他的注意力可以唤醒许多女人甚至不敢谈论的事情。每个客户都有自己的故事、创伤或秘密愿望。但如果其中一次会议不仅仅是工作呢？

当激情遇到信任，身体成为情感的管道时，每一个选择都可能导致爱、成瘾或毁灭。客户中有已婚女性、陷入浪漫纠葛的灵魂，以及那些正在寻找自己无法说出名字的东西的人。每一次接触都让托尼更接近实现他的真正角色。

《欲望之触》讲述了亲密关系如何治愈、摧毁并重新展现自己的故事。这是一款关于个人、道德和身体界限的游戏，以及当感情受到威胁时，界限是多么容易被模糊。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3787020/The_Lustful_Touch/]Steam[/url]]
